title: Existence of a maximal regular sequence and an auxiliary good-element setup
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-cm-module-good-element-nonzerodivisor, there exist a natural number d, with 1 ≤ d and supportDim R M = d, and a list fs of length d in the maximal ideal, regular on M, such that g is good for fs in the displayed support-dimension sense.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00N5, lines 25026-25048

proof.text: Finite local Krull dimension bounds supportDim M. The Cohen--Macaulay equality therefore makes depth a finite natural number d. The quotient M/gM is nonzero by Nakayama, so its support has nonnegative dimension. The given dimension equation forces d>=1 and, by cancellation in WithBot ENat, dim(Supp(M) intersect V(g))=d-1. This also excludes d=0.

Nakayama selects the supremum branch in the definition of depth. The set of regular-sequence lengths contains zero, and a finite supremum in ENat is attained. Thus choose a maximal regular list fs in the maximal ideal, of length d. This is proved directly in exists_sequence_of_depth_eq.

Induct on positive d, uniformly in the finite nonzero module. At d=1 the chosen regular list already works: goodness is required only at i=0, and is exactly the assumed cut dimension zero. At d=n+2 use the prime-avoidance lemma to choose x in the maximal ideal good for fs and satisfying dim(Supp(M/xM) intersect V(g))=n. The good-sequence theorem makes x regular and gives depth and support dimension n+1 for M/xM. Nakayama gives its nontriviality.

Apply induction to M/xM and g to obtain qs. Prepend x to qs; the regular-cons equivalence proves regularity on M, the length is n+2, and all entries lie in the maximal ideal. At i=0 goodness is the original cut hypothesis. At i=j+1, the quotient-support formula identifies Supp(M) intersect V(g,(x::qs).take(j+1)) with Supp(M/xM) intersect V(g,qs.take j). Inductive goodness and natural-number subtraction give the required equality.

lean.statement: theorem exists_good_sequence_for_cm_element {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Nontrivial M] (hCM : (IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) M : WithBot ℕ∞) = supportDim R M) (g : R) (hg : g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (hdim : Order.krullDim (support R M ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ({g} : Set R) : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) + 1 = supportDim R M) : ∃ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d ∧ supportDim R M = (((d : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧ ∃ fs : List R, fs.length = d ∧ (∀ f ∈ fs, f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∧ RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular M fs ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, i < d → Order.krullDim ((support R M ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus {x : R | x ∈ g :: fs.take i}) : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = (((d - i - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
